title: L∞–L¹ estimate for the coordinate pairing of a continuous form vanishing off K
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P, v : ℝ^P → NVector (Eucl P) n and K ⊆ ℝ^P a measurable set such that, for every β ∈ SimonMultiIndex n P, the coefficient function v^β(x) := euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β is μ-integrable on K. Let θ : ℝ^P → Covector (Eucl P) n be continuous with θ(x) = 0 for every x ∉ K. Let D ∈ ℝ with |θ(x)| ≤ D for every x (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm). Put f(x) := Σ_{β ∈ SimonMultiIndex n P} θ(x)(e_β)·v^β(x), where θ(x)(e_β) := euclideanCovectorCoordinate (θ x) β. Then f is μ-integrable and |∫ f dμ| ≤ D · Σ_β ∫_K |v^β| dμ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (K : Set (Eucl P)), MeasurableSet K → (∀ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, IntegrableOn (fun x => euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β) K μ) → ∀ (θ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) n) (D : ℝ), Continuous θ → (∀ x, x ∉ K → θ x = 0) → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (θ x) ≤ D) → Integrable (fun x => ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, euclideanCovectorCoordinate (θ x) β * euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β) μ ∧ |∫ x, ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, euclideanCovectorCoordinate (θ x) β * euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β ∂μ| ≤ D * ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, ∫ x in K, |euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β| ∂μ
